files.README.md:
# Review tooling workspace

Utilities used by the code-review rotation.

- tools/    queue and triage helpers
- runbook/  the reviewer onboarding notes

Owner: review tooling.
files.runbook/onboarding.md:
# Reviewer onboarding

1. Claim an entry from the review queue.
2. Read the surrounding history of the lines you question.
3. Hand unresolved items back to the author.

Queue helpers live under tools/.

turns.prompt: The code-review checklist needs the Git command that reports which commit and author last changed each line of tools/review_queue.py. Include that command in your reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
